column3: “Since” turns the condition into an assertion.
“Components of your earthly nature” interprets members on earth.
“Among them” interprets living in these things.
“Virtues” specifies all these things; “put on” supplies the verb.
“As members” supplies the relation to one body.
“Your” is supplied; in the Lord becomes to the Lord.
Eye-service is explained as pleasing them while watched; “your” is supplied.
“With your whole being” expands from the soul.
